TEMPLATES.note: Prioritize chest before shoulders. Warm up: 8 min bike + band work.
Incline first today — vary the pressing angle.
Keep the hinge neutral — quality over load.
Depth below parallel. Belt only on top sets.
Technique focus. Leave 2 reps in reserve everywhere.

NOTES.title: Carbs on training days
NOTES.body: Increase carbohydrate intake on training days. Use the pre-workout meal 90 minutes before training.

NOTES.title: Technique focus: hinging
NOTES.body: Hinge pattern improving with dowel drills. Keep RDL light — prioritize neutral spine over load for 3 weeks.

NOTES.title: Left knee — avoid deep flexion
NOTES.body: Physio confirmed patellar tracking issue. Replace lunges with box split squats, no jump variations.

NOTES.title: Deadlift PR — 145 kg
NOTES.body: Clean single at 145, bar speed still good. Next block: attack weakness off the floor → pause deadlifts.

NOTES.title: Protein target adjustment
NOTES.body: Struggling with 140 g protein. Agreed to add one shake + Greek yogurt snack to reach ~120 g first.

NOTES.title: Check-in call scheduled
NOTES.body: Missed 2 sessions. Call Thursday evening, discuss schedule barriers and possibly move to morning slots.

NOTES.title: Bench pause work helping
NOTES.body: Added 2-sec pause on last set — bar speed improved. Keep RPE 8 for 2 more weeks, then deload.

MSGS.body: Knee feels better this week — can we try box split squats?
Yes — replace lunges with box split squats at 3×10, keep them pain-free.
Protein target updated to ~120 g — see the plan.
Great session today — bench pause work is paying off. Keep RPE 8.
Check-in · Energy: Low · Soreness: Some · Sleep: Poor
